semantic_checks.conclusion: All outer controller modes hold one fixed /run/trnmponpublic-ci-owner.lock before fresh/reuse decisions and through cleanup/final lease validation. Root creation uses O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW and never truncates/replaces an existing inode. Opened FD must be a root/root 0444 empty regular file; LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB does not wait; post-flock lstat must match the held inode. Receipt-root-specific concurrent ownership is no longer possible through these entrypoints.

residual_risks_and_limits.detail: A real COMMIT followed by socket expiry, lost reply, storage failure or signing failure may still leave local and external checkpoints unequal and the client fenced. This fix only reconciles a complete authenticated matching receipt that is actually returned; it is not recovery of every uncertain CAS.

SQLite COMMIT, signing and mandatory History cleanup are not preempted at the instant a clock deadline passes. The existing nonblocking socket checks and final live fences reject late outward success; they are not hard real-time scheduling guarantees.

Actual sudo/systemd/cgroup/root-seal operation and all nine positive fixtures still need exact-source hosted execution. The 78 local Python controls include mocked root/systemd observations; marker-refusal and pidfd lifecycle controls cannot upgrade this to a real Host pass.

Main thread is rebuilding/testing the published final source with its original profile and single build job. Earlier 947/1/23, old CAS-category-candidate results and interrupted runs are historical evidence, not b280 qualification.

Generic continuous History remains explicitly denied until its durable operation owner exists. Retained completion identities are scoped to a live CPU owner, not restart-persistent authorization. The late-admission cold reopen follows exact retry/activation and does not prove the pre-retry durable activation state.

coverage_limits: The new witness controls force real pre-COMMIT expiry and real COMMIT crossing; they do not separately force a signing-only deadline crossing.

The late Current control proves client refusal of an authentic response delivered after the original deadline; service-final Current refusal is additionally established by the unchanged source branch.
The three History deadline controls expire inside the native closure, not exclusively during cleanup after an on-time native success; cleanup error precedence is verified statically.
A process-local retained completion identity or cold reopen after retry is not a durable live-authorization cache.
CI file/process receipts and libtest stdout remain execution observations, not an independent cryptographic execution oracle.
